description: Import an XML file into the structure (File > Import XML; Structure pane menu > Import XML) with the XML Import Options: merge or append, link to the file, XSLT, clone repeating text elements, only import matching elements, import text into tables, skip whitespace-only elements, delete unmatched content, CALS tables, and import into an element. The options given are kept as the document's XML import settings

createLink.description: Create Link: link to the XML file so it can be updated

deleteUnmatched.description: Delete Elements, Frames, and Content That Do Not Match Imported XML (merge only)

filePath.description: Absolute path of the XML file

ignoreWhitespace.description: Do Not Import Contents Of Whitespace-Only Elements

importCALSTables.description: Import CALS Tables as InDesign Tables

importTextIntoTables.description: Import Text Elements Into Tables If Tags Match (merge only)

importToSelected.description: Import into the element selected in the Structure pane (Import into Selected Element)

into.description: Import under this element instead of the root (Import into Selected Element). An XML element: its id (from list_xml_structure), its path of child indexes from the root element ([] is the root), the first element an XPath expression matches, or selection: true for the element selected in the Structure pane (or the selected tagged item). Give exactly one

path.description: Child indexes from the root, e.g. [0, 2] is the third child of the root's first child

selection.description: Use the element selected in the Structure pane

xpath.description: XPath expression evaluated from the root element, e.g. //article[@id="a1"]

mode.description: Merge Content (fill matching placeholders) or Append Content

onlyMatching.description: Only Import Elements That Match Existing Structure (merge only)

xslt.description: Apply XSLT (import): a stylesheet file, or the stylesheet named in the XML; enabled: false turns it off

enabled.description: false turns XSLT off (default true when the object is given)

file.description: Absolute path of the XSLT file

useStylesheetInXml.description: Use the stylesheet the XML file names (Use Stylesheet Specified in XML)

name: import_xml
title: Import XML
